Class employee_management

java.lang.Object
controller.employee_management
public class employee_management extends Object
Employee Management Page.

Handles the GUI and logic for the employee management page. This page allows a manager to view employee information, filter employees by role, add new employees, edit existing employee information, and delete employee records.

Employee information is stored in the project database and displayed through the employee table. This controller also handles navigation between employee management, inventory, menu management, reports, employee ordering, and the login page.

    • editing_id

      private int editing_id
      Stores the ID of the employee currently selected for editing.

      A value of -1 means that no employee is currently selected. The value is updated when an employee row is selected from the table.

    • loggedInManagerUsername

      private String loggedInManagerUsername
      Stores the username of the manager currently logged into the system.

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the employee management page when the FXML file is loaded.

      Sets up the available employee roles, role filter, and employee table columns. The method also adds listeners for table selections and filter changes so the page can respond when an employee row or role is selected.

      Employee information is loaded from the database when the page first opens. Clicking an empty area of the table clears the current selection and resets the employee input fields.

    • load_employees

      private void load_employees()
      Loads employee information from the database and displays the records in the employee table.

      The selected value in the role filter determines which records are retrieved. The table can display all employees, only managers, or only regular employees. All returned records are ordered by employee ID in ascending order.

      Each database record is converted into an observable row before being added to the table. If the query fails, an error message is displayed in the status label.

    • fill_fields_from_row

      private void fill_fields_from_row(javafx.collections.ObservableList<String> selected)
      Loads information from the selected employee table row into the employee editing fields.

      The employee ID is stored as the current editing ID so later save or delete operations can identify the correct database record. The first name, last name, role, phone number, email, and username are copied into their matching fields.

      The employee's existing password is not displayed. The password field is cleared whenever an existing employee is selected.

      Parameters:
      selected - selected table row containing the employee information

    • handleAdd

      private void handleAdd()
      Adds a new employee to the employees table using the values entered in the employee input fields.

      All required fields are checked before the database insert is performed. If any field is empty, the operation stops and an instruction is displayed in the status label.

      The employee ID is not manually inserted because PostgreSQL creates the next ID automatically. After a successful insert, the employee table is refreshed and the input fields are cleared.

    • handleEdit

      private void handleEdit()
      Prepares the currently selected employee record for editing.

      Employee information is already placed into the input fields when a table row is selected. This method checks that an employee has been selected and displays instructions to edit the fields and save the changes.

    • handleSave

      private void handleSave()
      Saves changes made to the currently selected employee record.

      The method checks that an employee has been selected and that all required employee fields contain values. The employee's first name, last name, role, phone number, email, and username are then updated in the database.

      The employee password is intentionally not updated by this operation, so the existing password remains unchanged. After a successful update, the table is refreshed and the editing fields are cleared.

    • handleDelete

      private void handleDelete()
      Deletes the currently selected employee record from the database.

      An employee must be selected before the delete operation can run. The stored editing ID is used to identify the correct record in the employees table.

      After a successful deletion, the employee table is refreshed, the table selection is removed, and the employee input fields are cleared.

    • clear_fields

      private void clear_fields()
      Clears the employee input fields and resets the current editing ID.

      This method only clears the fields used to add or edit an employee. The employee table and its loaded records are not removed. The editing ID is reset to -1 to show that no employee is currently being edited.

    • handleLogoutButtonClick

      private void handleLogoutButtonClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Logs the current manager out and returns to the login page.

      The employee or manager login FXML file is loaded and placed into the current application window. If the page cannot be loaded, the error is printed for debugging.

      Parameters:
      event - action event created when the logout button is selected

    • handleEmployeeModeButtonClick

      private void handleEmployeeModeButtonClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Switches from manager mode to the employee ordering page.

      The employee ordering FXML file is loaded and its controller receives the username of the manager currently logged in. This allows the same login information to remain available when entering employee mode.

      The current application window is found from the event source. Both normal JavaFX nodes and menu item events are supported.

      Parameters:
      event - action event created when employee mode is selected

    • handleReportsButtonClick

      private void handleReportsButtonClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Opens the manager reports page.

      Uses the shared scene switching method so the manager username remains available after moving to the reports page.

      Parameters:
      event - action event created by the reports navigation control

    • switchScene

      private void switchScene(javafx.event.ActionEvent event, String fxmlPath, String title)
      Loads a new FXML page and switches the current application window to the requested manager screen.

      After loading the FXML file, the method checks which manager controller was created. When supported, the username of the currently logged-in manager is passed to the new controller before the scene is displayed.

      The current stage can be found from either a normal JavaFX node or a menu item. If neither is available, the method attempts to locate the first visible application window.

      Parameters:
      event - action event that started the scene change
      fxmlPath - path of the FXML file for the destination page
      title - title displayed in the application window

    • handleBack

      private void handleBack(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Returns to the manager inventory page.

      Parameters:
      event - action event created by the back navigation control
